A '''great mansion''' was the home of [[Hetton]] and his [[Hetton's family|family]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]]. It was located in a [[Hetton's family estate|family estate]] directly outside [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Carannia/Legends|Carannia]]. One of many of the mansion's turrets prominently featured a [[Color/Legends|bright red]] flag with a family crest, a single gold eight-pointed star, which the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Zannah/Legends|Darth Zannah]] suspected was derived from the five-pointed star of [[House Demici/Legends|House Demici]].<ref name="RoT" />
